subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

While driving, Satheesh always / switches off his mobile phone / and kept it in the dashboard.

options.text: and kept it in the dashboard

solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: "**and kept it in the dashboard**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in the tense inconsistency between the phrases "**switches off his mobile phone**" and "**kept it in the dashboard**."
 
• The first phrase is in the present tense ("**switches off**"), indicating an action that is habitual o
